summary: polishD (src/09c_room.js only) is three small, local geometry fixes and all three move toward the photos with no new artefact. (1) The flush grey 10 cm shell band at the aisle bases is now a near-black 8 cm kick set 2 cm back under the aisle armrest housings and tall ash monument ends. It reads as the dark recessed plinth of c_27312 (under the monument end and side-table pedestal) and omaat_room_4 (black base under the next row's ash end). kick3 base box (330-440 x 455-495) RGB 28/27/30 -> 23/21/22. (2) The 11A footwell hairline is gone: crop (590-615 x 330-412) 48 px > L200 -> 0; > L120 137 -> 1; local speckles 130 -> 6. c_27316 shows no lit edge there either. (3) The 9 mm rounded cap rails give a soft rolled highlight instead of a single hard chamfer line (q10 / q09 / q08 caps). Box stats are neutral (q10 cap crop mean 107.6 -> 108.0, p99 unchanged), and there is no new shimmer on the far rows. The overall read is unchanged: clearly the same product with minor material and lighting differences. Holds 8.5 with no high or medium issues. Lighting noted, not scored.
photos_collected: Re-downloaded to ref/web/room/ with an rB_ prefix: omaat The-Room-4/6/7/13/15/23/24/31, kn_8, lalf_136/137 (lalf 136/137 turned out to be wing views). Base evidence: ref/ana c_27312 (crop 300-560 x 380-575: black recessed plinths under the monument end and pedestal, with a thin bright lip at the ash bottom edge), omaat_room_4 (crop 300-1200 x 450-900: black base under the far ash end), c_27316 (footwell mouth, no lit edge).
own_renders: No new renders. Used the supplied before/after renders plus diff maps and 2x crops in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/8dfc05b3-7f0a-5878-9342-17ccab4e499d/scratchpad/raterRoomB/ (k3z.png, kz.png, fwz.png, q09cap*.png, q10cap.png, q10far.png, q06aisle.png, *_diff.png).

issues.fix: Optional: in roomPart's monument end (09c_room.js, after the KICK box), add a 4 mm silver strip, e.g. B.add(gRBox(0.042, 0.004, ez1-ez0, 0.002, 1), M4.trs(0.566, KICK.h+0.002, ezc), {c:'#9a9ca0', r:0.3, m:0.6}). Only if it does not reintroduce a hairline at distance.

issues.title: Aisle armrest kick is flush on the seat side
issues.evidence: Code: the A-part kick spans ax0..hx-KICK.d, so it is recessed on the aisle face and the z ends only. On the seat side, an 8 cm black band sits flush where the shell used to be. It is hidden by the cushion in every QA view, so this is not visible.
issues.fix: None needed unless a lie-flat view shows it. If it does, shrink the kick to ax0+KICK.d..hx-KICK.d (width hx-ax0-2*KICK.d, centre (ax0+hx)/2).
